data.Author: (Linnaeus, 1758)
data.Comments: Oceanic and epipelagic, occasionally coming close to shore (Ref. 5288). Undertakes long seasonal migrations across the North Atlantic and enters the Mediterranean Sea to spawn (Refs. 26340 and 30874). Feeds on small schooling fishes such as herring and mackerel, and on squid and crustaceans. Body temperature is maintained above ambient by counter-current heat exchangers, which supports foraging in cold, productive waters at high latitudes. Larvae and juveniles occupy warm surface waters, while adults regularly dive below the thermocline.
data.Remark: Two populations, western and eastern Atlantic, are managed separately.
